parsed.why: No trans-specific offence, no border or police targeting, embedded third-gender tradition and court protections; but current harassment and physical/sexual abuse of visibly trans people in provincial cities, rising political hostility, thin recourse.

Morality code criminalises same-sex conduct, provincial caning, presidential decree framing LGBTQ as security threat, vigilante mobs, venue raids, and a trans traveller's death in custody: organised, state-licensed targeting.

No criminalisation and functioning document reform, but martial-law border stops of male-marker holders, gatekept diagnosis, hate-crime gap, and dated violence with weak police response; wartime strain.

No entry, border or screening provisions, no criminalisation, courts struck down anti-LGBT provisions; but police failed assembly protection, systemic workplace discrimination, thin hate-crime recourse.

Never criminalised, visible Pride scene and tourism welcome; but documented police abuse of trans women (forced bathing, exclusion), 135+ street harassment cases, dated arrest survey, no anti-discrimination recourse.
